note: Finn's sighting of Roz is now leverage that needs the harbour tide board, which gives Finn no reason to speak of Roz: a lock with no fitting reason that the structural checks accept.

patch.value: Finn doesn't think Roz's visit matters until he hears the tide schedule was changed. A clever question about who was alone in the cottage yesterday can also jog his memory.
Finn will not say who he saw in the cottage until you have read the harbour tide board.
